headlines.text: On a Wednesday in 2023, back when the AEW TNT Title changed hands as Powerhouse Hobbs vs. Wardlow battled it out in a Falls Count Anywhere match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.03 ? ending the champion's reign at 9 defenses. Wardlow was chasing gold for the 10th time. With Wardlow's gear and title stolen from his own rental car the night before, this personal Falls Count Anywhere brawl wrecked a Cadillac before QT Marshall's interference helped Hobbs win the TNT Title.
Rewind to 2025, when Momo Watanabe laced up for their first AEW match against Serena Deeb, appearing on Collision, rated 6.92.
On this day in 2024, The Butcher was back in action after 6 weeks away, appearing on Rampage.

secondaries.text: It was 2025 when Tony Nese returned to the fold after just under 3 months away, appearing on Collision.

Turning the clock back to 2024: Marq Quen reached a solid half-century of matches: their 50th match in AEW, facing Top Flight vs. Private Party vs. Keith & Komander, headlining the show on Rampage, rated 5.95 in a physical tag team battle.
It was 2025 when Daniel Garcia vs. Lee Moriarty closed out Collision, rated 7.24 ? a good, competitive contest.
